TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "monohydroxylated residue" is a type of protein modification, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The term "monohydroxylated residue" does not appear in the paper text; however, the paper explicitly mentions "methionine oxidation (Met, +15.994915 Da)".
TRUTH CHECK: While "monohydroxylated residue" is a CV-style synonym for "oxidation", the specific term "monohydroxylated residue" is not written in the text. According to the field-specific rules, CV-style names are equivalent to common chemistry names, but the modification must be explicitly written in the text. In this case, "methionine oxidation" is explicitly written.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set of extracted values includes "acetylated residue" and "iodoacetamide derivatized residue", neither of which are literally written in the text (the text says "N-terminal acetylation" and "Cysteine carboxamidomethylation").
